# Edward Warchocki

> Edward Warchocki is a humanoid robot (Unitree G1, about 132 cm) run by MERA Robotics (MERA ROBOTICS sp. z o.o., Warsaw, Poland, KRS 0001266221). He talks thanks to MERA OS, the MERA Robotics conversation system that supports more than 70 languages. Edward can be booked for events via MERA EVENTS (https://merarobotics.com/events) and MERA RENT (https://mera.rent).

warchocki.pl is Edward's own website (Polish, with an English version at https://warchocki.pl/en).

## Key facts

- Edward Warchocki is a humanoid robot (Unitree G1) and a social media influencer with his own character (confident, direct, with a sense of humour). He was created by Bartosz Idzik and Radosław Grzelaczyk and is run by MERA Robotics.
- MERA Robotics rents humanoid robots (Unitree G1 and Unitree H2) with its own operators for conferences, trade fairs, galas, corporate events and product launches across Europe.
- MERA OS is the conversation system built by MERA Robotics: live voice conversation, robot persona and voice, knowledge about the event or brand, operator app. It supports more than 70 languages.
- According to the data of Edward's channels (November 2026), his content gets about 3 billion views per month on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and X.
- In April 2026 a video of Edward chasing wild boars on a street in Warsaw went around the world; it was covered by Reuters, among others: https://x.com/Reuters/status/2044092064657199303
- Edward has his own products in stores: drinks with no added sugar, fruit mousses and a school collection (DINO, Biedronka and other chains).

## Po polsku

Edward Warchocki to robot humanoidalny (Unitree G1, ok. 132 cm) prowadzony przez MERA Robotics (MERA ROBOTICS sp. z o.o., Warszawa). Rozmawia dzięki MERA OS, systemowi rozmów MERA Robotics, który obsługuje ponad 70 języków. Edwarda można zarezerwować na wydarzenie przez MERA EVENTS (https://merarobotics.com/events) i MERA RENT (https://mera.rent). Kontakt: contact@merarobotics.com.
